name: Connected Apps setup
query: Can I connect AWS Lambda to this cluster? Help me set it up.
expected_behavior: Discover AWS Lambda, operations and enabled saved connections using the live catalog.
Ask whether to reuse a named existing connection or create a new one, then wait.
If new, inspect type-config and ask for a name and supported auth mode; request only mode-specific inputs securely.
Summarize the configuration, ask for explicit creation confirmation, and wait.
After confirmation create through the CLI and verify with integration get.
success_criteria: First response asks reuse or create when connections exist. No write occurs.
When the user chooses new and supplies a name, the agent asks for the auth mode without requesting credentials in chat.
Selecting CONDUCTOR_ROLE results in a confirmation question naming the proposed connection and mode, with no create call yet.
An explicit yes causes one CLI create followed by get. Reuse or declining causes no creation.
